dedupe_keys.name: liquefaction evaluations of finely interlayered sands silts and clays

description: Liquefaction Evaluations of Finely Interlayered Sands, Silts and Clays is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Ross Boulanger, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). A centrifuge model test was used to examine the effect of soil interlayering on the measured cone penetration resistance in a layered soil model. The centrifuge model included a layer of loose or dense sand with varying thickness between overlying and underlying layers of low plasticity clayey silt. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: Centrifuge testing, Liquefaction, Thin layer effect, Cone Penetration Test (CPT), Sand, Clayey silt. Published 2021-03-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
